The series has strong seasonality and unstable model rankings, making robust combinations like trimmed_mean effective. The current leader (a11) uses a trimmed mean on a pool of stable models. To test if weighting by recent performance could improve upon the equal-weight/trim logic, I will use `weights_error_trend` which adapts to models that are improving, combined with the same stable pool (pool1). This addresses the "ranking instability" and "medium predictability" aspects by giving more influence to models showing positive error trends.

Series context: trend strength 0.0142 and seasonal strength 0.9486; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.197); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.515.
